changelog: Layout fixed so nothing can hide off-screen, and design buildings really save now. (1) The Zone Buildings split divider actually drags both ways — make the data side or the 3D building view as wide as you want; it remembers where you left it while the app is open. (2) The whole window fits a 1366-wide screen maximized: the wide control rows now scroll sideways instead of pushing content off the edge, and long labels shorten with the full text on hover. (3) The Open Building box splits evenly between Categories and Buildings, and both sides can be dragged. The Building design tabs and the Subdivisions tab got the same adjustable splits (drag between the picture and its panel). (4) DESIGN BUILDINGS NOW SAVE TO GITHUB: your design buildings (the samples and the 535 house) download from GitHub when the editor opens, and saving — including Push & Close at the quit prompt — sends them to GitHub, then downloads them back to prove they arrived. Before this fix, a design edit such as a roof colour never left the laptop even when the app said the push succeeded; any roof-colour edit still sitting on your laptop will be picked up and published by your next save.
